name: Bridge at Honan opposite to Canton
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A drawing of an arched bridge, with houses built out on wooden piles, in the district of Guangzhou south of the Pearl River known as Henan, Honan or Honam. For a view of the same subject from a slightly different angle see E.1765-1928. See also E.1766-1928 for a related drawing executed on the same

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
